description: The first embedding-fronted fighter in the league: Model2Vec sentence-embedding similarity leads at high confidence, Padatious's trained template classifier backs it at medium.
notes: HYPOTHESIS: none of the existing fighters (frankenparse, padapt, nebulatious, nebulapt, palavadapt) use embeddings at all — every stage in every prior fighter is either keyword-rule matching or a trained-per-intent template classifier. m2v-first tests whether leading with a general-purpose sentence-embedding similarity engine (Model2Vec, config-verified in ovos_m2v_pipeline/__init__.py: model default 'Jarbas/ovos-model2vec-intents-distiluse-base-multilingual-cased-v2', conf_high/conf_medium/conf_low keys) — which generalizes across paraphrases via embedding distance rather than exact template/keyword matching — beats a template classifier leading, when Padatious backs it up at medium. This isolates 'does an embedding-similarity front door change which utterances get caught first' from every non-embedding fusion already in the league. Distinct paradigm from Jurebes/Padatious (learned per-intent classifiers over hand-engineered or TF-IDF features) and from Nebulento (fuzzy string edit-distance, not vector similarity).
